meta.description: Single-ingress router for all ERP → n8n events. Receives POST /webhook/erp-event-bus {event, emitted_at, payload}, routes on body.event to the appropriate sub-workflow. 33 events routed (all ErpEventName values); unknown events fall through to Log unhandled event for observability. Cron workflows (03 lead stale, 08 vendor payment due) are self-triggered — they don't flow through this router. Events with no dedicated downstream workflow are routed to 55-global-error-handler with a TODO note.
